thread:
Maya (CSM): Hey team — post-cutover check for SecureBridge private/VPC deploy. Devon reported higher-than-expected failed audit log uploads overnight. Can we triage?
Devon (Customer): +1, saw ~120 failed PUTs to our audit-bucket between 02:00-03:30 UTC. App logs show 503s then retries. Nothing obvious from our side.
Nidhi (Solutions): Thanks Devon. Do you have the error snippet? also which KMS key is used for the bucket?
Devon (Customer): Error: "ServiceUnavailable: 503" in the agent logs. KMS key: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/4a5b6c7d. Bucket is securebridge-audit-prod-us-east-1.
Sam (Security): Quick check: are the KMS key policy and key grants present for Redwood's audit-shipper role? If key was recently rotated we might see transient access issues.
Maya (CSM): Devon — did you rotate keys during the cutover window? I recall ops performed firewall rule tightening too.
Devon (Customer): We rotated a secondary key earlier this week but not the primary. Firewall changes were applied at 01:45 UTC per infra ticket.
Nidhi (Solutions): That timing aligns. Two hypotheses: 1) egress path to S3 was blocked during the firewall rule change causing 503s, 2) the shipper retried and temporarily hit rate limits or increased backpressure. Can we get shipper logs for 02:00-04:00?
Devon (Customer): Pasted a snippet: ```2026-03-22T02:14:07Z ERROR audit-shipper Upload failed for file=logs/2026-03-22/02/14/part-12.gz error=ServiceUnavailable status=503 retry=1```
Sam (Security): Also check CloudTrail for KMS:Decrypt events around that time to ensure decryption attempts succeeded. If KMS denied, logs show AccessDenied rather than 503 though.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: rollout/securebridge-audit-shipper v1.4.2 completed at 2026-03-22T01:40:00Z by infra-team
Maya (CSM): OK — immediate ask list: (1) Devon: export shipper logs 01:30-04:30 and share
(2) Nidhi + Sam: validate KMS grants & CloudTrail Decrypt entries 01:30-03:30
(3) Nidhi: check shipper metrics for retry/backoff spikes and S3 5xx rates
Devon (Customer): Uploaded logs to our shared folder: https://rwd-securebridge-shared/logs/securebridge/2026-03-22-shipper.tar.gz
Nidhi (Solutions): Got it. Initial glance: retry count spikes at 02:12-02:20 and 03:05. I'll correlate with S3 request metrics and the firewall change window.
Sam (Security): Confirmed: CloudTrail shows KMS:Decrypt successes at 02:10 and 03:05 — no AccessDenied. KMS rotations look fine. Key grants include the expected role.
Nidhi (Solutions): S3 server-side metrics show a brief 5xx spike from 02:10-02:22 (p99 latency up, 5xx rate ~1.8%). Firewall change was applied at 01:45 and reversed for troubleshooting at 02:25. So likely transient network gating during rule rollout.
Maya (CSM): Thanks — sounds like the firewall change caused packet loss/backoff that triggered retries and audit upload failures. Renewal risk/health note: Devon, this caused delayed audit arrival and 2 customers queried retention visibility. We should log this as a post-cutover action and add a rollback/playbook for firewall changes during ingest windows.
Devon (Customer): Agree. Impact: delayed availability of last-hour audit logs for ~1.5 hours. Not a data loss but caused alert noise in downstream monitoring. We want mitigation steps before next renewal check.
Maya (CSM): Action items captured: - Nidhi to add an explicit pre-cutover check: verify egress ACLs and a synthetic S3 upload test during maintenance windows (owner: Solutions). - Infra to avoid firewall apply during peak ingestion windows or use staged rules (owner: Infra). - Ops to add alert for sustained S3 5xx > 1% over 10m (owner: Customer/Redwood joint). - CS to note as renewal risk item (ops noise + visibility impact).
Nidhi (Solutions): Working on a small script for the synthetic check; will post PR with runbook snippet: ```# synthetic upload test
curl -sS https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/securebridge-audit-prod-us-east-1/test-upload --upload-file /tmp/ping.txt || echo FAILED```
Sam (Security): Also recommending a short-lived Canary KMS key grant for shipper during maintenance to reduce blast radius of rotations.
Devon (Customer): Can we schedule a dry-run next Tuesday 03:00-04:00 UTC to validate?
Maya (CSM): Proposed: Tuesday dry-run + runbook verification. I'll schedule a call and flag renewal owner.
ops-bot: Reminder: runbook task created: RB-6428 "securebridge: audit upload post-cutover runbook" assigned to Nidhi
Maya (CSM): Thanks everyone. Filing this under the customer health board and I'll include in the QBR notes as a renewal chatterpoint. :memo:
Devon (Customer): Appreciate the quick triage. Will watch for the dry-run invite.
Nidhi (Solutions): I'll follow up later today with the runbook PR and a short pager with test results.
Sam (Security): Added a short checklist for KMS rotations and firewall staging to the internal security playbook.
Maya (CSM): Closing the thread for now — reopen if further failed uploads appear. :thumbsup:
